summary: Allows a detached accessory dwelling unit (DADU) to be built behind a single-family home on a legally created lot that is smaller than its district's minimum lot size, as long as the lot is at least 3,750 square feet and the DADU meets all other Metro Code rules.

judge.problem: The summary says the DADU is built "behind" the single-family home. The ordinance says only that the DADU is an accessory to a single-family structure and must meet Section 17.16.030.G and other Code requirements. It sets no placement behind the house. The 3,750 sq ft minimum and the requirement to meet other Code rules are accurate.
